<noinclude>
Template for displaying lab room/location information in a standardized format.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Lab Room
|name=Room 201
|room_number=201
|building=Science Building
|floor=2
|capacity=10
|manager=[[Personnel:Jane Smith]]
|description=Main lab space with fume hoods
|status=Active
|created_date=2024-01-15
|last_updated=2024-01-15
}}
</pre>

== Parameters ==
* name - Room name (required)
* room_number - Room number
* building - Building name
* floor - Floor number
* capacity - Maximum occupancy
* manager - Link to personnel page managing the room
* description - Description of the room
* status - Status (Active, Inactive, Under Renovation)
* created_date - Creation date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* last_updated - Last update date (YYYY-MM-DD)

[[Category:Template]]
</noinclude>
